failureDialogs.text:
Failure dialogs (system alerts, not screens)
Each is a native alert with one OK button.
• Save transaction (add form, details sheet): "Could not save the transaction" · "Tapahtuman tallennus epäonnistui" · "Не удалось сохранить транзакцию"
• Delete transaction (selection mode, details sheet): "Could not delete the transaction" · "Tapahtuman poisto epäonnistui" · "Не удалось удалить транзакцию"
• Save category (editor sheet): "Could not save the category" · "Kategorian tallennus epäonnistui" · "Не удалось сохранить категорию"
Texts: failed keys in frontend/src/locales. Debug panel alerts are dev only and untranslated.
